Remarks: Content match clearing will set all the same values to null values. For example, a = {1,1,2,3}, if 1 is set to a null value, then it will be a = {nil，nil，2,3}.

Name: Clear any group
Remarks: Delete all values of the group

Name: Insert any value in any group
Remarks: Inserting forward will affect the sequence. For example, if 5 is inserted into a = {1、2、3、4} in the second position, then it will be a = {1、5、2、3、4}.

Name: Delete the value of specified number in any group
Remarks: Deleting a value will affect the sorting, and the following value will go forward. For example, after deleting 2, a = {1、2、3、4} will become a ={1、3、4}.

Name: Delete any value in any group
Remarks: Content match clearing. For example, if 1 is deleted in a = {1,1,2,3}, all 1 will be deleted. It will become a = {2,3}.

Name: Clear the null values of any group
Remarks: Automatically carry after the empty value is cleared. For example, after clearing, a = {1、nil、2、nil、nil、3} becomes a ={1、2、3}.

Name: Add a set of values to any group
Remarks: Add all the values of Group b in the original order at the end of Group a, including null values. For example, a = {1，2，3}, b = {4，5，6}. Add b to a, then a = {1，2，3，4，5，6}.

Name: Set a set of values to null in any group
Desc: Set repeated values with |@2| to null in |@1|
Remarks:
1. De-duplication. Set the duplicate values in Group A and Group B to null values. Duplicate null values will not be deleted.
 2. If there are multiple duplicate values, the first value will be set to null first. Take a = {1，1，1，2，3} b = {1，1，2} for example, it will become a = {nil，nil，1，nil，3}, first set 1 where ix = 1 and ix = 2.

Name: Delete a set of values in any group
Desc: Delete the repeated values with |@2| in |@1|
Remarks:
1. De-duplication. Delete duplicate values in Group A and Group B, duplicate null values will be deleted.
 2. If there are multiple duplicate values, the first value will be deleted first. Take a = {1，1，1，2，3} b = {1，1，2} for example, after deletion, it will become a = {1，3}, first delete 1 where ix = 1 and ix = 2.

Name: Insert a set of values in any group
Desc: Insert all values of |@3| in |@2| position of |@1|
Remarks:
1. Inserting forward will affect the sequence. For example, if b = {5，6，7} is inserted into a = {1，2，3，4} in the second position, then it will be a = {1，5，6，7，2，3，4}
 2. If there is no value at the inserted position, it will be the same as the assignment. For example, if b = {4，5，6} is inserted into a = {1，2，3} in the fourth position, then it will be a = {1，2，3，4，5，6}.
